description: This Java source file defines the "AcksUpdater" class, which manages local acknowledgment labels in a distributed pub/sub system. It handles subscription management, updates to distributed data (DData), and coordination with cluster members to ensure acknowledgment labels are correctly synchronized and conflicts are handled.

classes.name: AcksUpdater
classes.description: Manages local declared acknowledgment labels in a distributed pub/sub system, coordinating with Akka cluster features and distributed data (DData) to ensure acknowledgment labels are unique and properly synchronized across cluster members.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object for creating an AcksUpdater actor with specified configuration, subscriber, and distributed data access.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message-handling behavior of the actor, reacting to replicator changes, cluster member removal, and other messages.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the logging adapter used for this actor.

methods.name: getDDataWriter
methods.description: Provides access to the DData writer for updating acknowledgment labels in the distributed data store.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, accepting or rejecting based on acknowledgment label conflicts.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Handles unsubscription requests, but currently logs a warning for unexpected input.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Triggers periodic flushing of local DData updates to the replicator.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful DData operations, currently logs unexpected successes.

methods.name: onChanged
methods.description: Processes DData change events, identifying subscribers who lost race conditions and handling failures accordingly.

methods.name: writeLocalDData
methods.description: Sends updates to local DData with current subscription state, handling errors.

methods.name: failSubscribe
methods.description: Notifies a subscriber that their acknowledgment label registration failed due to non-uniqueness.

methods.name: areAckLabelsDeclaredHere
methods.description: Checks whether acknowledgment labels in a subscription conflict with existing local declarations.

methods.name: getLocalLosers
methods.description: Identifies local subscribers who lost race conditions for acknowledgment label declaration based on remote data.

methods.name: areTopicsClaimedRemotely
methods.description: Checks whether the topics claimed in a subscription are already claimed by remote acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: isSmallerThanMySubscriber
methods.description: Compares two subscribers to determine if one is 'smaller' for race condition resolution.
